note: The Sunday before Easter, commemorating Jesus’s entry into Jerusalem; date changes each year.

senses.m: The Sunday before Easter, commemorating Jesus’s entry into Jerusalem
senses.pat: Palm Sunday service · celebrate Palm Sunday · Palm Sunday procession
ex: The church held a Palm Sunday procession.
Nhà thờ tổ chức đoàn rước vào Chủ nhật Lễ Lá.
Palm Sunday falls one week before Easter Sunday.
Chủ nhật Lễ Lá diễn ra một tuần trước Chủ nhật Phục Sinh.

note: A sequence of documents or records showing how a decision or transaction happened; increasingly may include digital records.

senses.m: A sequence of documents or records showing how a decision or transaction happened
senses.pat: leave/create a paper trail · follow the paper trail · a clear paper trail
ex: The auditor followed the paper trail to identify the payment.
Kiểm toán viên lần theo hồ sơ giấy tờ để xác định khoản thanh toán.
Keep a paper trail for every expense claim.
Hãy lưu hồ sơ cho từng khoản đề nghị hoàn trả chi phí.

note: An open area where troops or other groups assemble or march in formation.

senses.m: An open area where troops or other groups assemble or march in formation
senses.pat: on the parade ground · drill on the parade ground · parade-ground ceremony
ex: The recruits assembled on the parade ground at dawn.
Tân binh tập hợp trên sân duyệt binh lúc bình minh.
The ceremony took place on the old parade ground.
Buổi lễ diễn ra trên sân duyệt binh cũ.

note: An area where vehicles can be parked; US English. British English usually car park.

senses.m: An area where vehicles can be parked
senses.pat: park in a parking lot · a multistory parking lot · parking-lot entrance
ex: We left the car in the parking lot near the station.
Chúng tôi để xe trong bãi đỗ gần nhà ga.
The shopping center has a large parking lot.
Trung tâm mua sắm có bãi đỗ xe lớn.

note: A notice or fine issued for a parking violation; also a ticket purchased to pay for parking in some places. Context determines whether it is a penalty or proof of payment.

senses.m: A notice or fine issued for a parking violation
senses.pat: get/receive a parking ticket · pay a parking ticket · parking-ticket machine
ex: She got a parking ticket for overstaying the limit.
Cô bị phạt vì đỗ xe quá thời gian quy định.
Put the parking ticket on the dashboard as proof of payment.
Đặt vé đỗ xe lên bảng điều khiển làm bằng chứng đã thanh toán.

note: A shot in tennis or another racket sport that passes an opponent positioned near the net.

senses.m: A shot in tennis or another racket sport that passes an opponent positioned near the net
senses.pat: hit a passing shot · a cross-court passing shot · save a passing shot
ex: She hit a passing shot down the line.
Cô đánh một cú passing shot dọc biên.
The player chased down the passing shot but could not return it.
Vận động viên đuổi theo cú đánh vượt qua nhưng không trả bóng lại được.

note: A flowering vine in the genus Passiflora; some species bear edible passion fruit, while others are grown ornamentally.

senses.m: A flowering vine in the genus Passiflora
senses.pat: a purple passion flower · passion-flower vine · grow passion flowers
ex: A passion flower opened on the garden trellis.
Một bông hoa lạc tiên nở trên giàn trong vườn.
The plant produces both flowers and edible fruit.
Cây này cho cả hoa và quả ăn được.

note: The edible fruit of several Passiflora species, with aromatic pulp and seeds; varieties differ in color and flavor.

senses.m: The edible fruit of several Passiflora species, with aromatic pulp and seeds
senses.pat: passion-fruit juice · scoop out passion fruit · passion-fruit dessert
ex: She added passion fruit to the yogurt.
Cô thêm chanh dây vào sữa chua.
The dessert was topped with fresh passion-fruit pulp.
Món tráng miệng được phủ phần ruột chanh dây tươi.

note: A dramatic reenactment of the suffering and death of Jesus, especially during Holy Week; traditions and staging vary.

senses.m: A dramatic reenactment of the suffering and death of Jesus, especially during Holy Week
senses.pat: stage a Passion play · the Oberammergau Passion Play · perform the Passion
ex: The village stages a Passion play every ten years.
Ngôi làng dàn dựng vở diễn về cuộc Thương khó mười năm một lần.
The church group rehearsed the Passion play for Easter.
Nhóm nhà thờ tập vở diễn Thương khó cho dịp Phục Sinh.

note: A police vehicle used to transport officers or detainees; term especially associated with older US usage.

senses.m: A police vehicle used to transport officers or detainees
senses.pat: arrive in a patrol wagon · load someone into a patrol wagon · police patrol wagon
ex: The officers arrived in a patrol wagon.
Các sĩ quan đến bằng xe tuần tra của cảnh sát.
The old patrol wagon is displayed in the police museum.
Chiếc xe tuần tra cũ được trưng bày trong bảo tàng cảnh sát.

note: A system in which income tax is deducted from wages as they are paid; abbreviated PAYE in the UK and other countries.

senses.m: A system in which income tax is deducted from wages as they are paid
senses.pat: pay-as-you-earn tax · PAYE system · tax deducted under PAYE
ex: Income tax is collected through the pay-as-you-earn system.
Thuế thu nhập được thu qua hệ thống khấu trừ khi trả lương.
Her employer deducts tax under PAYE.
Chủ lao động khấu trừ thuế theo hệ thống PAYE.

note: An envelope containing an employee’s wages, especially cash wages; historically also the document listing pay details.

senses.m: An envelope containing an employee’s wages, especially cash wages
senses.pat: receive a pay envelope · open a pay envelope · weekly pay envelope
ex: Workers received their pay envelopes on Friday.
Công nhân nhận phong bì tiền lương vào thứ Sáu.
The pay envelope included a printed wage statement.
Phong bì lương có kèm bảng kê tiền công được in.

note: A gift or friendly act intended to end a disagreement or show a desire for peace.

senses.m: A gift or friendly act intended to end a disagreement or show a desire for peace
senses.pat: bring a peace offering · a small peace offering · accept someone’s peace offering
ex: He brought flowers as a peace offering after the argument.
Anh mang hoa đến làm quà giảng hòa sau cuộc tranh cãi.
The apology was her peace offering to the neighbors.
Lời xin lỗi là cử chỉ giảng hòa của cô với hàng xóm.

note: A person with whom one exchanges letters, often without meeting; British English. US English usually pen pal.

senses.m: A person with whom one exchanges letters, often without meeting
senses.pat: write to a pen friend · become pen friends · an overseas pen friend
ex: She found a pen friend through a school exchange.
Cô tìm được bạn thư tín qua chương trình trao đổi của trường.
They remained pen friends for years before meeting.
Họ làm bạn thư tín nhiều năm trước khi gặp nhau.

note: A name an author uses instead of their legal name; also pseudonym or nom de plume.

senses.m: A name an author uses instead of their legal name
senses.pat: write under a pen name · adopt a pen name · publish under a pen name
ex: The novelist published her first book under a pen name.
Tiểu thuyết gia xuất bản cuốn đầu tiên dưới bút danh.
He chose a pen name to keep his writing separate from his job.
Anh chọn bút danh để tách việc viết lách khỏi công việc chính.

note: A person with whom one exchanges letters, often without meeting; US English. British English often pen friend.

senses.m: A person with whom one exchanges letters, often without meeting
senses.pat: write to a pen pal · find a pen pal · become pen pals
ex: I had a pen pal in Japan when I was a child.
Hồi nhỏ tôi có một người bạn thư tín ở Nhật Bản.
The class exchanged letters with their pen pals abroad.
Lớp học trao đổi thư với các bạn thư tín ở nước ngoài.

note: A small simple fipple flute, traditionally made of metal or wood; also called a tin whistle or Irish whistle.

senses.m: A small simple fipple flute, traditionally made of metal or wood
senses.pat: play a penny whistle · a tune on the penny whistle · penny-whistle music
ex: He played a folk tune on a penny whistle.
Anh thổi một giai điệu dân gian bằng sáo penny whistle.
The band included a penny whistle and fiddle.
Ban nhạc có sáo penny whistle và đàn fiddle.

note: The ability to identify or reproduce a musical note without a reference tone; also called absolute pitch.

senses.m: The ability to identify or reproduce a musical note without a reference tone
senses.pat: have perfect pitch · demonstrate perfect pitch · perfect-pitch musician
ex: She has perfect pitch and can name each note she hears.
Cô có thính giác tuyệt đối và có thể gọi tên từng nốt nhạc nghe được.
Perfect pitch is uncommon but not required for musicianship.
Thính giác tuyệt đối không phổ biến nhưng không phải điều kiện để chơi nhạc giỏi.

note: An affectionate nickname used for a loved one; can also mean a name given to a pet animal.

senses.m: An affectionate nickname used for a loved one
senses.pat: call someone by a pet name · a private pet name · choose a pet name
ex: They called each other by a private pet name.
Họ gọi nhau bằng một biệt danh âu yếm riêng.
The family chose a pet name for the new puppy.
Gia đình chọn tên gọi thân mật cho chú chó con mới.

note: To gradually stop producing, using, or providing something, often replacing it with another system.

senses.m: To gradually stop producing, using, or providing something, often replacing it with another system
senses.pat: phase out a product · be phased out gradually · phase out the old system
ex: The company will phase out the older model next year.
Công ty sẽ ngừng dần mẫu cũ vào năm tới.
Coal power is being phased out over several decades.
Điện than đang được loại bỏ dần trong vài thập kỷ.
